featured_reviews.name: Madar Subedar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Event Date: 10 December 2026
Guest Count: 1,000 Pax
"We recently hired Food Forest Caterer for a grand 1,000-guest event, and they exceeded every expectation. Managing a crowd of this size is no small feat, but their team handled the logistics with absolute precision and grace.
The Menu Highlights:
5 Starters: The variety was incredible. From the Chicken Afghani Tikka to the Paneer Banjara, each starter was served piping hot with perfect marinades.
Mutton Main Course: A true standout. The rich, slow-cooked flavors of the Mutton (Mutton/Meat) dishes—specifically the Lucknowi Korma—were authentic and became the talk of the night.
5 Live Counters: These added a fantastic interactive element to the evening. The Pasta Station, Chinese Wok, and Rabdi Jalebi counters were bustling but moved quickly thanks to the efficient, well-trained staff.
Service & Execution:
For a 1,000-pax gathering, service flow is critical. Food Forest provided a premium buffet setup with dedicated staff that kept the area clean and the food replenished without any delays. Their 'Royal Style' hospitality made every guest feel like a VIP.
If you are looking for a caterer in Mumbai that can balance large-scale production with five-star food quality, I cannot recommend Food Forest enough. They truly deliver on their promise of 'flavours that impress'."

featured_reviews.name: Rehan Saiyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the pleasure of hiring Food Forest Catering for our Walima celebration in Mumbai with around 2000 guests, and the experience was truly excellent. From the beginning, Afzal Khan and his team were very professional, cooperative, and well organized.

The food quality was outstanding and received many compliments from our guests. The Chicken Biryani, kebabs, starters, and desserts were all delicious and prepared perfectly. The buffet setup was elegant, and the service team managed the large crowd very smoothly.

Handling catering for such a big Muslim wedding event is not easy, but Food Forest Catering did a fantastic job with timely service and great presentation. Everything was arranged properly, and the guests were very happy with the food and hospitality.

We highly recommend Food Forest Catering to anyone looking for reliable catering services for weddings, walima, and large events in Mumbai. Thank you to Afzal Khan and the entire team for making our celebration memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Tauheed
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hired Food Forest Caterer for our Walima on March 30, and it was an absolutely stellar experience! Managing a guest list of 2,000 people is no small feat, but the team handled it with incredible professionalism and precision.
The Food: Every dish was served fresh and full of flavor. The Mutton Raan and Dum Biryani were the highlights—perfectly spiced and cooked to perfection.
Love Station (Live Stations): The 'Love Station' (Live Gourmet Station) was a massive hit with the guests. Having high-capacity live counters ensured that despite the large crowd, everyone received hot, fresh food without long wait times.
Service & Setup: The buffet layout was elegant and well-organized. The staff were trained, cooperative, and ensured that the replenishment was seamless throughout the night.
Reliability: For a gathering of 2,000, coordination is key. Food Forest’s experience in large-format events really showed, making our special day completely stress-free.
If you are looking for a caterer that can handle a grand scale while maintaining 5-star quality and taste, I highly recommend Food Forest!"

featured_reviews.name: EM
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Outstanding! Handled our 1800-guest event like absolute professionals
We recently hosted a massive family wedding + reception in Mumbai with 1800 pax, and choosing Food Forest Caterer was one of the best decisions we made. From the very first meeting, their team was extremely responsive, professional, and genuinely excited to make our event memorable.
What blew us away was how flawlessly they managed such a huge crowd. The buffet setup was elegant, well-organized, and spacious — no long queues, even during peak hours. They had multiple live food counters (pasta, chaat, dosa, and grill stations) that kept the food fresh and hot throughout. The variety was incredible — both veg and non-veg options were top-notch.
The food itself was restaurant-quality even at this scale. The starters were crispy and flavorful, the mains (especially the butter chicken, paneer lababdar, biryanis, and dal makhani) were rich, aromatic, and perfectly spiced. Guests kept going back for seconds and thirds! The desserts section was a total hit — fresh gulab jamuns, rasmalai, and the ice cream counter disappeared in no time.
What impressed me most was the hygiene, presentation, and service. Every dish looked beautiful, the staff was courteous, well-trained, and super efficient. They maintained the buffet perfectly for hours without any mess or delay. The setup, crockery, and overall presentation gave our event a premium, luxurious feel.
For an order of this magnitude (1800 people), we were a bit nervous about consistency and timing, but Food Forest delivered beyond expectations. Everything was on time, piping hot where it needed to be, and the portion sizes were generous — we actually had compliments from guests saying it was one of the best catered weddings they’ve attended.
Huge thanks to the entire team at Food Forest Caterer for making our big day stress-free and delicious. If you’re planning any event — wedding, corporate, or large celebration — and need reliable catering that can handle big numbers without compromising on quality, look no further. Highly recommended!
Would book them again in a heartbeat.
— Farhan Munshi (Mumbai)

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Dhamapurkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have ordered from Shri Ekvira Caterers on multiple occasions, and each time they have delivered an exceptional experience. They catered for my wedding festivities including Mehendi and Haldi, as well as my mother-in-law’s retirement party at her office and party hall and every event was handled with absolute perfection.

The food quality is outstanding — hygienic, fresh, flavourful and consistently delicious. Every dish reflects their commitment to taste and quality. Their kothimbir vadi deserves a special mention — it was included in all our events and became an absolute favorite among our guests. It was always perfectly crisp, flavourful and irresistible. The chicken prepared for the Haldi function was another highlight — incredibly tasty, well-cooked and loved by everyone.

What truly sets Ekvira Caterers apart is their professionalism and clear communication. From planning to execution, everything is smooth and stress-free. They always suggest excellent menus based on the occasion, guest profile and preferences, which makes decision-making easy and ensures a perfect dining experience.

Their service, presentation, punctuality and attention to detail make them a reliable and trusted choice for any celebration. I highly recommend Shri Ekvira Caterers to anyone looking for amazing food, hygiene, quality and seamless service. They truly make every event memorable! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Dipesh Gad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the pleasure of engaging Ekvira Caterers for our wedding functions for four days, and the experience was truly outstanding. Their team demonstrated exceptional attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to quality service.

The food quality was the highlight of the entire event. Every meal was fresh, authentic, and rich in taste which was truly comparable to home cooked food. The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the same was appreciated by all our guests. It is rare to find wedding catering that delivers both large scale service and such homely taste, but Ekvira Caterers managed it

The staff was courteous, well organized, and ensured smooth operations throughout all four days without any delays or issues. Their dedication made our wedding functions stress-free and enjoyable for us and for guests as well.

After experiencing such excellent service and food quality, I confidently referred Ekvira Caterers to one of my close friends, who also took their service and was delighted with their quality of food and service.

I would highly recommend Ekvira Caterers to anyone looking for reliable catering with authentic taste and superior service quality. They truly made our wedding celebrations memorable with their exceptional culinary experience and flawless execution

featured_reviews.name: tanvi dhupkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The food we ordered from this catering company was absolutely delicious! Every dish was fresh, flavourful, and you could really taste the quality and care that went into the preparation.

The service was smooth and professional, and everything arrived right on time, which made the whole experience stress-free. Our guests loved the food.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for reliable catering with amazing taste we’ll definitely be ordering again!

featured_reviews.name: Aaditya Karekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently took catering services from Ekvira Caterers for my dad’s 60th birthday, and it turned out to be an excellent decision. The food was absolutely delicious — every guest appreciated the taste, quality, and variety.

A special mention to Bhavik Patil for his superb coordination and support throughout. He was extremely helpful, responsive, and made sure everything was handled perfectly. The team was punctual, professional, and their overall setup and service added a great touch to the celebration.
Thank you, Ekvira Caterers and Bhavik Patil, for making the occasion memorable. Highly recommended for any family function or event!

featured_reviews.name: Manav Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Ekvira caterers Provide Amazing food and excellent service! Every dish was flavorful and fresh, and the staff was extremely courteous and helpful. The quick service and welcoming attitude made the experience even better. Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.name: Chandrakant B.
featured_reviews.review_text:
We got to know about Shri Ekvira Caterers through online media. We ordered the food on three different occasions. The food was fresh, delicious and of excellent quality.  Waalachi Usal and Kothimbir Wadi was liked by our guests the most!!
We appreciate their timely delivery of food, cooperative and efficient staff, cleanliness they maintained. Highly recommended....!!

featured_reviews.name: Kreative Kendra
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered food for 300 people and the experience was superb The food quality was very good and everything is fresh and delicious The service was  also very smooth Ekvira caters handled the large order very professionally Highly recommended for large events
